strategy: Proceed forward while continuously scanning for obstacles, adjusting direction to avoid collisions and ensure a safe path to the goal.

decisions.condition: no obstacle directly ahead and path to goal is clear
decisions.reason: to move toward the goal while maintaining a clear path

decisions.condition: obstacle detected ahead but clear path to the left
decisions.reason: to avoid obstacles by redirecting to the left

decisions.condition: obstacle detected ahead but clear path to the right
decisions.reason: to avoid obstacles by redirecting to the right

decisions.condition: obstacle ahead with no clear left or right path, or goal reached
decisions.reason: to ensure safe stop when no path is available or goal is achieved

stop_condition: when the robot reaches the goal or detects that all paths are blocked, ensuring a safe stop
